provenance.note: Self-authored non-looped scripts. Sentence/paragraph voices en/de. Silence padding and synthetic articulation are not microphone or Swiss-German acceptance.

fixtures.reference: Before we leave the workshop, please check the blue microphone beside the window. The recording should stay on this computer. I will review every sentence before sending the message, especially the final words: green bicycle.

Bevor wir die Werkstatt verlassen, prüfe bitte das blaue Mikrofon neben dem Fenster. Die Aufnahme soll auf diesem Computer bleiben. Ich lese jeden Satz vor dem Senden noch einmal, besonders die letzten Wörter: grünes Fahrrad.
Bitte öffne das Fenster und stelle das Mikrofon auf den Tisch. The recording stays on this computer, and I will check the final message before sending it. Am Ende steht das Wort Sonnenblume.

Please write down the following instructions carefully. Put the yellow screwdriver beside the silver microphone, then carry the small cardboard box across the workshop. We need international cooperation, accurate measurements, and a clear final sentence about the mountain railway.
